cues.title: 一杯绿色，只有一种色素吗？
cues.caption: 同一份绿色滤液，可能含有不同色素。
cues.captionEn: One green extract can contain several pigments.
cues.zh: 这份滤液看起来只有一种绿色，能说明里面只有一种色素吗？先跟住叶片中的几类标记。它们原本在细胞内部，研磨破坏结构，溶剂把色素提取出来。过滤留下较大的残渣，溶解的色素仍混在一起。所以，提取成功只是获得样品；要区分成分，还需要新的证据。
cues.en: This extract looks uniformly green. Does that establish that it contains only one pigment? Follow several marked pigment classes inside the leaf. Disrupting the tissue gives solvent access to them. Filtration retains larger debris, while dissolved pigments remain together. Extraction gives us a sample. Separating its components requires another piece of evidence.

cues.title: 为什么同一起点会丢失？
cues.titleEn: How can the shared origin be lost?
cues.caption: 共同且集中的起点，才能比较迁移。
cues.captionEn: Keep the origin shared and narrow.
cues.zh: 把同一份混合物集中在一条细线上。溶剂能沿纸上升，但色素线开始时应在液面上方。现在只升高液面：标记进入槽液，纸上的共同起点变弱了。恢复正常位置，起点才保持可比较。细线也很关键：一开始铺得太宽，后面即使迁移不同，色带仍可能重叠。
cues.en: Concentrate the same mixture at one narrow origin. Solvent can rise through the paper, while the pigment line begins above the liquid. Raise only the liquid level: marked pigment enters the reservoir and the controlled origin weakens. A narrow origin also matters. If the initial zone is too broad, components with different migration can still overlap.

cues.title: 不是跑得快，而是停留得不同
cues.titleEn: Different time spent moving and retained
cues.caption: 分配差异累积成迁移差异。
cues.zh: 前沿继续上升，色带却渐渐分开。放大纸上的一小段，跟住两种标记。处在流动相里的部分会被带走，留在固定环境里的部分暂时落后；交换反复发生。不同色素在这两种环境中的分配不同，许多次累积后，形成不同的迁移距离。这里用一个简化分配模型解释过程，不把色带位置当作分子大小排名。回到整张纸，四类主要色带分开了。再预测：如果两种色素在新的条件下分配相同，它们还能靠这次层析分开吗？
cues.en: The solvent front rises, yet the pigment bands separate. Zoom into one region and follow two marked pigments. The portion in the mobile phase is carried forward; the retained portion stays behind for a while. Repeated exchange accumulates into different migration distances. Our simplified distribution model explains that process. It does not rank molecules by size or claim universal migration ratios. Returning to the whole paper reveals the main bands. Now predict: if two pigments have the same distribution under new conditions, will this separation still distinguish them?

cues.title: 绿色是留下的光，还是吸收的光？
cues.titleEn: Is green light absorbed or left over?
cues.caption: 同波长比较入射与透过，才能判断吸收。
cues.zh: 另一条证据来自光。先看空白溶剂，再放入色素溶液，保持光程和浓度条件清楚。比较同一波长进入和离开的光，才能判断吸收。叶绿素a在蓝光和红光附近吸收较强，绿色区域透过较多，但并不是完全不吸收。图中比例来自测得的光谱系数。看见绿色，不能反过来说它最强地吸收绿色。
cues.en: Light provides a different kind of evidence. Compare a solvent blank with the pigment solution under stated concentration and path-length conditions. Incoming and transmitted intensity must be compared at the same wavelength. Chlorophyll a absorbs strongly near blue and red, while more green light passes. Green absorption is not zero. These fractions come from measured spectral coefficients. Seeing green does not mean that green is the strongest absorption region.

cues.title: 把光谱变成一个可检验的预测
cues.titleEn: Turn the spectrum into a testable prediction
cues.caption: 浓度加倍：透过率 T → T²。
cues.zh: 三种色素的峰位不同，这也是独立区分样品的线索。这里比较的是指定溶剂中的测量，不是整片叶的光合效率。现在保留同一种色素和波长，只把浓度加倍。第二份相同的吸收作用再次减少剩余的光：透过比例要相乘，不是直接减去一半。预测之后再揭晓结果。色带位置回答如何分离，光谱回答哪些光被吸收，这两项证据不能互相替代。
cues.en: The three pigments have different spectral peaks, providing another way to compare samples. These measurements use specified solvents and do not directly measure whole-leaf photosynthesis. Keep one pigment and wavelength fixed, then double its concentration. An equal additional absorbing amount acts on the light that remains: transmission fractions multiply rather than simply halving. Predict before revealing the result. Migration and absorption answer different questions; neither measurement substitutes for the other.

question.zh: 同一份绿色滤液，为什么分成不同色带？
question.en: Why does one green extract separate into different bands?

lead.zh: 跟住同一份混合物，再放大两种色素如何随流动相移动或暂时停留。
lead.en: Follow one mixture and zoom into pigment moving with solvent or remaining retained.

principle.zh: 不同色素在流动相和固定环境间的分配不同，反复交换累积成不同位移；起点和条件必须可比较。
principle.en: Different distributions between mobile and stationary environments accumulate into different migration; origins and conditions must be comparable.

question.zh: 两种色素在新条件下分配相同，还一定出现两条色带吗？
question.en: If two pigments have equal distributions under new conditions, must two bands appear?

explanation.zh: 在该理想模型中会共同迁移，单条带也不能单独证明只有一种色素。
explanation.en: In the ideal model they co-migrate. A single band alone does not establish a single component.

question.zh: 看起来绿色，为什么红光、蓝光反而吸收较多？
question.en: Why can a green solution absorb red and blue more strongly?

lead.zh: 保留同一波长，直接比较入射光和透射光，再用实测谱线检验预测。
lead.en: Compare input and output at the same wavelength, then test a prediction with measured spectra.

principle.zh: 选择性吸收改变剩余光；在指定溶剂、浓度和光程下可由消光系数求透过率，但不能直接等同整叶光合效率。
principle.en: Selective absorption changes the remaining light. Extinction coefficients predict transmission under stated conditions, not whole-leaf photosynthetic efficiency.

question.zh: 同种色素浓度加倍，透过率一定只剩原来的一半吗？
question.en: Does doubling pigment concentration always halve transmission?

explanation.zh: Beer–Lambert模型给出T(2c)=T(c)²。原来透过约97%的绿光，加倍后仍约94%，并非约48%。
explanation.en: Beer–Lambert gives T(2c) = T(c)². About 97% green transmission becomes about 94%, not about 48%.

translations.分配与类型标记是教学模型，不是微观录像或标准迁移系数。: Partitioning and class markers are teaching models, not molecular footage or standard migration values.
translations.同一标记在流动相和固定环境间反复交换: Persistent markers exchange between mobile and stationary environments
translations.同一波长的空白、样品和透过比例；下方为实测系数计算的曲线: Blank and sample transmission at one wavelength, with a curve calculated from measured coefficients
translations.同一迁移条件下比较窄起点和宽起点: Narrow and broad origins under identical migration conditions
translations.吸收使用实测系数；忽略散射、反射与荧光。: Measured extinction coefficients; scattering, reflection and fluorescence omitted.
translations.溶液测量，不等同叶片光合效率: Solution data, not leaf photosynthetic efficiency
translations.第二份吸收作用于剩余的光: The next amount acts on remaining light
translations.色带由同一分配模型计算，液面与起点分别可见: Pigment bands from the same distribution model, with a separate reservoir and origin
translations.跟踪色素从叶绿体到仍然混合的滤液: Follow pigment classes from a chloroplast to a mixed filtrate
translations.透过率相乘，不是简单减半: Transmission multiplies; it does not halve
translations.原点保持同一高度: The origin stays at the same height
translations.共同且集中的起点，才能比较迁移。: Keep the origin shared and narrow.
